# Fresh Coast AI

> Practical AI adoption for businesses ready to own it. Fixed-fee engagements from readiness assessment to implementation. Founded by Jon Linton in Milwaukee, Wisconsin.

Fresh Coast AI helps businesses across the United States adopt AI confidently. We are vendor-neutral, people-first, and every engagement is designed to end: your team owns the capability when we're done.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.freshcoast.ai/): Overview of Fresh Coast AI's approach to AI consulting
- [About](https://www.freshcoast.ai/about): Background on founder Jon Linton: 13 years in change management, international business development, and AI transformation
- [Services](https://www.freshcoast.ai/services): AI consulting service tiers, pricing, and what's included
- [How We Work](https://www.freshcoast.ai/how-we-work): The Assess → Build → Own methodology
- [Deliverables](https://www.freshcoast.ai/deliverables): Sample deliverables clients receive

## Service Tiers & Pricing

- AI Readiness Assessment: starting around $5,000, a full organizational AI readiness evaluation
- AI Implementation: $8,000–$55,000, end-to-end workflow design, build, and team training

Engagements are fixed-fee, scoped and priced upfront, with a $5,000 minimum.
